notes: עַל־נְקַלָּה is treated as a rule 30 fusion rendered by the single word 'slightly', contiguous and with no morpheme owning a part of the English; the competing rule 40 reading is named in the unit note.
The waw before אֵין שָׁלוֹם takes the connective the ASV actually writes, 'when' (rule 14), and the existential takes its full presentative frame headed on 'no' (rule 50).
The repeated שָׁלוֹם at s012 and s013 is separately rendered, so rule 22 does not apply to it; only one occurrence would go unrepresented if the ASV had written 'Peace' once.
